message.text:
SQL Injection in product search (q parameter)

The `q` query parameter of GET /rest/products/search is concatenated into a SQL statement without parameterisation. A single quote followed by a UNION SELECT returns rows from the users table.

errow.impact: An unauthenticated attacker can read arbitrary database content, including credential hashes of every account.
errow.technical_analysis: Response time differential (SLEEP) and boolean-based probes confirmed injection into a string context; UNION column count is 9.
errow.remediation_steps: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements for every database access and stop returning raw database errors to clients.
errow.counterevidence: No WAF or input filter was observed between the client and the application.
errow.severity_change_conditions: Severity drops to medium if the database account is read-only and holds no credential data.
errow.fix_verification: Re-run the UNION and boolean probes after deploying parameterised queries; both must return an empty result set.

poc.description: GET /rest/products/search?q=')) UNION SELECT id,email,password,4,5,6,7,8,9 FROM Users-- returns user rows in the product list.
